capabilities: Catalog games, anime, movies, TV shows, books, and manga in six independent libraries
Fetch metadata and posters from providers such as Steam, TMDB, and MyAnimeList
Track status, rating, favorite, and season/episode, page, chapter, or volume progress
Browse collections in customizable card grids with search, filters, sorts, and saved views
Visualize collection statistics with status and rating distribution charts
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a worldbuilding or lore-keeping tool; it catalogs entertainment media like games, films, and books.
extras: README states privacy-first local storage with no accounts, cloud sync, or telemetry; remote poster fetching via URL is marked experimental; some provider names appear only as removed links in the integration tables.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track and browse entertainment media collections, so users must manage statuses, ratings, and progress by hand across plain notes.
